stories.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
stories.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

stories.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
stories.summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

stories.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
stories.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

stories.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
stories.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.
